notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one permanent of each color.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding three mana of each color.
Activate Legacy Weapon by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, exiling Eternal Scourge.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
When Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
